scope: local implicit accuracy and algebraic-convergence audit; not a stiffness or positivity guarantee
working_tree: includes the uncommitted native-convolution and SOE work
design_basis: informed by exploratory float64 17-node probes, before the full sweep
nonlinear_feedback: -strength*(y^3-u^3) for the scalar; -S*R*((S^-1*y)^3-u^3) for coupled cases, R=[[strength+1,-strength],[-strength,strength+1]]
independent_discrete_residual: float64 panel quadrature: 32-point Gauss-Legendre away from the singular endpoint, exact beta moments on the newest panel; no imported solver weight helpers
measurements: finite trajectory, self-reported convergence/failure counts, max and endpoint dimensionless error, minimum dimensionless state, independent scaled residual and flag disagreements
failure_policy: retain all runs; finite but unconverged trajectories retain labeled accuracy measurements; nonfinite trajectories have empty accuracy/residual fields
check_policy: require the complete unique matrix and coherent output/diagnostic shapes, flags and counts; do not require all solves to converge or satisfy an accuracy threshold
stopping_rule: one full sweep per precision; retain unfavorable cases without changing grids, iteration counts, diagnostic tolerances or solver defaults
